name: Message
description: One message in a channel (forge 26d-3): Markdown text, its author, whom it mentions, its files, and the message it replies to in a thread. Its id is the one its sender's browser made, so a message posted twice is one. Edited and deleted only by its author; a deleted message keeps its place with no text

fields.name: Author (name)
fields.description: Who wrote it when not a person of the tenant: an agent, or an outside author through a bridge

fields.name: Reply to
fields.description: The message whose thread it is in; empty in the channel itself

fields.name: Private
fields.description: Its channel's, copied so the row rule needs no lookup
